list.description: Every actor in this workspace and what it is made of.

agentsHere.title: Agents here
agentsHere.basis: organization count not recorded · {listed} listed below

enrolled.title: Enrolled
enrolled.observe: {count} listed here on the observe tier, the rest on harness
enrolled.mixed: {observe} listed here on the observe tier, {harness} on harness, {other} on another tier or none recorded

mandate.title: Holding a mandate
mandate.scope: Counted over the agents in {workspace}. No organization-wide rollup is recorded yet.

tamper.title: Tamper incidents
tamper.none: none in the retention window in {workspace}
tamper.scope: Summed over the agents in {workspace}. No organization-wide rollup is recorded yet.

list.title: Registered in {workspace}

lead.composition: Each row names the reusable objects this agent holds a reference to.
lead.operations: Each row is what this agent did and what it cost over the last 30 days.

cells.tokensBasis: {count, plural, one {# wrapped session} other {# wrapped sessions}}, as the harness reported them. Ledger runs' tokens are not in this total.
cells.spendBasis: Priced wrapped sessions in the last 30 days. Ledger runs and unpriced sessions are not in this figure.

health.tamperWhy: {count, plural, one {# open incident} other {# open incidents}}
health.notEnrolledWhy: no hook is installed, so its runs are recorded only
health.observeWhy: enrolled, and nothing is delivered or refused yet
health.healthyWhy: enrolled, and its latest wrapped session recorded the {tier} tier
health.retiredWhy: retired, so its credential and hosts are revoked and no hook is installed
health.suspendedWhy: suspended, so every call is refused and there is no health verdict

list.footer: An agent has one principal and runs on one runtime. Its steering, its toolbelts and its tools are workspace objects it refers to, so changing one changes every agent that refers to it.

empty.title: No agent registered in {workspace}
empty.body: An agent's identity lives in Postgres; its definition is a file in <mono>.oxagen/agents/</mono> in the main repo. Registering one opens a Context PR — nothing is written to Postgres first.

register.title: Register an agent
register.slugHint: The agent key becomes <mono>{key}</mono> and is immutable.
register.avatarHint: The definition carries no avatar yet, so the agent shows these initials.
register.note: This does not write Postgres. It opens a Context PR that adds <mono>{path}</mono> and the generated harness file beside it. The agent gets its principal when it registers from where it runs, after the merge.
register.done: Pull request #{number} opened. The agent exists when it merges.
register.invalidSlug: Use lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens, at most 18 characters.
register.designNote: Designing an avatar needs an avatar field on the definition, and the definition carries none yet. The agent shows these initials until it does.
register.slugHintEnding: The agent key ends in <mono>.{slug}</mono> and is immutable.

error.title: Agents could not be loaded
error.body: The control plane answered <mono>{status} {code}</mono>. Nothing was changed. Runs kept recording while this page was down. Frames are written by the collector on each host, not by Oxagen.

denied.title: You cannot see the agents in this workspace
denied.body: Your roles on {org} do not include {permission} on {ws}. An organization owner can grant it; the grant is a governed action and lands in the audit record with your name on it.

pending.title: Access to the agents in this workspace is waiting for approval

gaps.steering: No store records the steering assembled for each agent yet.
gaps.toolbelt: No store records toolbelts or their assignments to agents yet.
gaps.tokens: No wrapped session of this agent reported its token usage in the last 30 days. Ledger runs' tokens are not rolled up per agent.
gaps.commit: The commit of .oxagen/agents/ is not recorded on this read.
gaps.organization: No organization-wide rollup of agents is recorded yet.
gaps.tier: No wrapped session has recorded an enforcement tier for this agent yet, and no per-agent tier rollup exists (#3817).
gaps.runtimeKind: No store records a runtime's kind yet. A host row is one enrollment, not a machine.
gaps.belt: list_agents does not compute each agent's belt yet (#3852). The agent's own page shows the belt its grants give it.
gaps.policy: The read's refusal does not name the policy that decided it yet (#3846).
gaps.trace: A failed read does not carry its trace id or region yet.

stubs.requestBody: A request would ask an organization owner for this role and land in the audit record with the granter's name, your name, and your reason. No capability records a request yet, so ask an owner directly. Owners grant roles on the Roles page.
stubs.incidentBody: An incident would record this failure, the code {code}, and when it happened, for the people who run this workspace. No capability opens an incident from the console yet. Send the code to your organization owner.

avatar.title: Edit avatar
avatar.body: Oxagen would store an icon, up to three letters, or a photo as this agent’s avatar. No store holds an agent avatar yet, so the card shows the first two letters of its slug.

facts.title: Identity
facts.lead: In Postgres, and revocable at the next call.
facts.principalSub: minted at registration and never reused. A retired agent’s runs keep their identity.
facts.modelTierSub: as the definition file names it
facts.operatorSub: accountable for every run · IAM field initiating_principal
facts.lifecycleSub: registered → enrolled → active → retired. Deregistering retires the principal and never deletes it, so old runs keep their identity.

credentials.title: Credentials
credentials.lead: The single property most of the threat model rests on.
credentials.runTokenValue: one, and it reaches Oxagen only
credentials.body: It holds one run token, and that token is good for talking to Oxagen and nothing else. Every secret a call needs is minted by the broker at dispatch, scoped to that one call, and never transmitted to the agent. A leaked run token cannot reach a provider.
credentials.connections: See the connections that mint them

runCredential.title: Run credential
runCredential.lead: Long-lived, purpose-locked, hashed at rest, shown to the operator once.
runCredential.empty: The agent holds no long-lived credential.
runCredential.keySub: shown once at issue; stored as a hash
runCredential.runTokensSub: Revoking the key or suspending the agent kills every run token at the next call. This is what makes a halt stick.

change.title: Change identity
change.body: Oxagen would move this agent to act on behalf of another person, with the new parent’s approval, and recompute its delegation ceiling at the next call. No contract changes an agent’s operator yet, so nothing changes.

revoke.title: Revoke credential
revoke.body: Oxagen would revoke this key alone and kill every run token at the next call. No contract revokes one agent credential yet. Rotate credential replaces the key, and Suspend stops the agent.

trust.title: Trust relationships
trust.lead: Who this principal answers to, and what will speak for it.
trust.humanSub: every run of this agent carries their name as initiating_principal
trust.workspaceSub: the principal is scoped to it and cannot be used in another
trust.runtimeSub: its device key signs this agent’s checkpoints
trust.delegationSub: a subagent’s effective permission is this agent’s grants ∩ the invoking human’s grants
trust.replaySub: what a reader can do with this agent’s frames after the fact, as its newest run recorded

assign.title: Assign a role
assign.hint: Only agent-kind roles are listed. <link>Manage roles</link>
assign.empty: This organization has no role an agent may hold. Write one on the Roles page, then assign it here.
assign.notEnforced: On the {tier} tier the kernel allows every capability, so this role records intent and governs nothing until the organization moves to a tier that enforces it.
assign.partial: This organization has more roles than the 200 listed here. Assign one of the rest over the API.
assign.whyPlaceholder: Read by the approver and kept in the audit record
assign.note: Effective permission stays <mono>roles ∩ {operator}'s grants</mono>. A role cannot lift an agent above its operator.
assign.noteNoOperator: Effective permission stays <mono>roles ∩ the operator's grants</mono>. A role cannot lift an agent above its operator.
assign.repositoryGap: No role can be bound to one repository yet (#3865). A role applies at its own scope: the organization or this workspace.
assign.done: {role} assigned to {key}{why}. Recorded with your name; effective at its next call.
assign.doneNotEnforced: {role} assigned to {key}{why}. Recorded with your name. It governs nothing until the organization's tier enforces roles.

revoke.title: Revoke {role}
revoke.body: The agent stops holding {role} at its next call. The assignment stays in the audit trail.

computation.title: Belt computation
computation.lead: At run start, recomputed on any deny-generation bump.

ceilingValue.caller: the agent's grants intersected with yours
ceilingValue.sentinel: no person resolved, so the unprivileged ceiling

computation.body: This agent’s model is shown {count} tools. The {off} listed under Off the belt are not, and the model is never shown them.

model.title: Model view
model.over: The belt is {count} tools, over this workspace’s full-belt limit of {limit}, so it is presented as a {mode} belt.
model.under: The belt is {count} tools, under this workspace’s full-belt limit of {limit}, so it is presented as a {mode} belt.
model.searchableBody: The request carries the search and load meta-tools, and the model finds a tool before it calls it. This is a preview and changes nothing about how the agent runs.
model.fullBody: Every definition is in the request, and there are no meta-tools to call. This is a preview and changes nothing about how the agent runs.

block.searchable: the meta-tools of the next model request
block.full: {count} definitions, each named with its schema digest

model.trailer: The design puts a machine-readable trailer on every definition: the risk grade, whether the call is held, the ceiling, and the schema digest. The belt does not record the description or the trailer yet, so the block shows the names and digests it does record.

search.title: Belt search
search.lead: This matches the tool names on the belt the model is shown; the search_tools index itself is not read here.
search.label: Search this agent’s belt
search.matched: {hits} of {total} belt members matched. The model sees names and one-line descriptions, and calls load_tools to see a schema.
search.nothing: Nothing on this agent’s belt matches that.
search.outside: {tool} exists in the registry, but it is not on this agent’s belt:
search.never: A search never returns a tool outside the belt. What the model cannot call, it cannot find, and so cannot be prompt-injected into calling.

rules.title: Per-tool decision rules
rules.lead: What the policy engine answers for each member of this belt, before the call is made.
rules.empty: The belt is empty: the model is shown no tool.

categories.title: Tool categories
categories.body: A category is a registry attribute the tool version was published with. It says what a tool acts on, and a rule may reference it.
categories.axes: Only the risk grade, the side effect, the financial class and the egress carry a decision by themselves. This belt records the risk grade and whether the tool writes.

off.title: Off the belt
off.lead: The tools the registry holds that this belt leaves out, and the rule that left each one out.
off.empty: Every tool in the registry is on the belt.

schema.title: Input schema
schema.none: No input schema is recorded for this tool.

origin.imported: Imported from the server's tool list.

schema.copyFailed: Copy it by hand: this browser refused the clipboard.
schema.truncated: This schema is larger than the belt carries inline. The digest identifies it; read the full schema from the tool registry.

enroll.title: Enroll a host under {name}
enroll.body: Mint a single-use token, then run the command below on the machine. The token is shown once and is consumed the first time it is presented.
enroll.once: Shown once. Mint another if it is lost or expires unused.
enroll.copyFailed: Copying is blocked in this browser. Select the text and copy it.

revoke.label: Unenroll {hostname}
revoke.title: Unenroll {hostname}
revoke.body: The host's key is retired and every session on it is denied at its next prompt or tool boundary. Enrolling the machine again mints a new key. This cannot be undone.
revoke.reasonHint: Recorded on the host row and on the revoke command. Optional.

incidents.title: Tamper incidents

empty.title: No tamper incident recorded
empty.lead: list_incidents holds none for this agent.
empty.body: Detectors that would raise one: {kinds}. Each is a security event with who, why, and what it stopped.

incidents.note: A tamper incident never raises the tier of the frames it touched. The window it covers stays labeled as what was actually observed, which is why the count here and the count on the Audit page are the same number read from the same record.

definition.unparsed: The file does not parse at line {line}: {reason}. Fix the line in the source editor; the form patches nothing until it reads.

bar.against: against {branch} at {commit}. Nothing is written until you commit.
bar.againstSeed: against a file that has not been committed. Nothing is written until you commit.
bar.pending: Last committed at {commit}. The merge of its pull request is not recorded here, so the running definition is the default branch’s until it merges.

identity.title: Identity
identity.slugHint: Immutable. The agent key {key} is derived from it.
identity.name: Name
identity.descriptionHint: One sentence. Shown on the Agents list and in every receipt this agent produces.

model.title: Model and budget
model.tierHint: complex routes to the workspace's complex model and light to its light one. The harness makes the call with its own key; Oxagen records what it reports.
model.budgetHint: Stored as budget = '{' per_run_micros = {micros} '}'. Once a wrapped session's observed spend reaches it, Oxagen's local model proxy refuses the session's next model call.
model.budgetDayHint: Stored as budget = '{' per_day_micros = {micros} '}'. A day is a UTC calendar day. Once the agent's observed spend that day, on every host enrolled under it, reaches this figure, the model proxy refuses its next call until 00:00 UTC. Empty or 0 sets no daily ceiling. Hosts older than the daily_budget feature do not receive it.

tools.title: Tools
tools.toolsHint: Patterns against the registry. github__* grants every github tool the operator can delegate.
tools.denyHint: A deny here wins over any grant. A version pattern like @* denies every version.
tools.addPlaceholder: add a tool pattern, Enter to keep
tools.write: May write through the gateway; every write is a receipt.
tools.irreversible: Needs an active mandate. This agent holds {count, plural, =0 {none} one {one} other {#}}.
tools.irreversibleUnknown: Needs an active mandate. The mandate ledger did not answer, so none is known to be active.

instructions.title: Instructions
instructions.label: Instructions
instructions.hint: Compiled into the harness file beside this one. Keep credentials and personal data out of it: nothing checks for them before a commit.

harness.title: Harness
harness.harnessHint: Set at registration. Changing it is a new agent.
harness.colorHint: Cosmetic: the label the harness shows on its own screen.

source.title: Source
source.lead: Every field on this page is a view of that file. Editing here patches one key in place; editing there changes anything. Both go through the same commit.
source.uncommitted: No definition is committed yet. Saving commits this file to a branch and opens a pull request.

changing.title: Changing this agent

edit.title: 1 · Edit here or in the repository
edit.body: Either opens a pull request. Nothing is written to Postgres first.

checks.title: 2 · Checks
checks.body: Before the pull request opens, Oxagen checks the file's schema, that the slug is this agent's, and that every registered capability it names is one you hold yourself. Tool patterns and MCP tools are not checked here. Your repository's own checks run on the pull request.

review.title: 3 · Review
review.body: A code-owner review is required before the merge.

merge.title: 4 · Merge is the change
merge.body: The merged file is the definition of record. The next run on this repository reads it from the default branch.

changing.note: Deleting an agent is a pull request that removes the file. The principal is retired, never deleted, so its runs keep their identity.

budgets.title: Ceilings above this agent
budgets.lead: The organization and workspace spend ceilings, set on Spend and enforced across every agent in their scope.
budgets.basis: Spent is metered from priced model calls over the period named in each row. A run Oxagen did not price is in no figure here.
budgets.empty: No spend ceiling is set for this workspace or its organization.
budgets.agentScope: Oxagen records no ceiling for one agent. get_spend_budget reads the organization and workspace scopes only, so this agent is bounded by the rows above and by the per-run budget its definition sets. A per-agent ceiling waits on an ADR for the scopes billing.budgets accepts.

costCenter.title: Cost center for {name}
costCenter.body: Runs rolled up after this change are charged to the label you choose. Runs already rolled up keep the label they had.
costCenter.empty: This organization has no cost centers. Add one on the Organization page, then charge this agent to it here.

tokens.title: 30-day token use
tokens.none: The 30-day rollup holds no row for this agent.
tokens.inputSplit: Input is recorded as one figure, {input} tokens, and not split by class yet. The six input classes wait on that split.
tokens.cacheRateValue: {rate} · {read} of {input} input tokens served from cache

basisValue.gateway_observed: observed by the gateway proxy from the bytes that passed through it
basisValue.mixed: partly observed by the gateway and partly reported by the harness

coaching.title: Coaching
coaching.notBacked: Coaching is read off the token classes, and the record does not split input by class yet. Nothing is suggested until it does.

composition.title: Composition
composition.lead: One principal, and a reference to every other object it uses.
composition.identitySub: minted at registration and never reused
composition.steeringSub: assembled from the workspace library on this agent’s newest run
composition.steeringNoneSub: steering is a workspace library; this agent holds a reference, never a copy
composition.toolbeltNotBacked: Toolbelts are not stored as objects yet, so no assignment can be named here.
composition.toolbeltSub: {count, plural, one {# tool} other {# tools}} in all, sent as a {mode} belt
composition.toolbeltUnread: the belt could not be read
composition.ownerSub: accountable for every run this agent makes
composition.mandates: {count, plural, =0 {no mandate} one {# mandate} other {# mandates}}
composition.permissionsSub: a toolbelt says what it can see; its roles and the policy say what it may call

last30.title: Last 30 days
last30.lead: This agent’s own rollup, the same one the Agents table reads.
last30.runsNone: no run on the newest page of runs

health.tamper: {count, plural, one {# open incident} other {# open incidents}}
health.notEnrolled: no hook is installed, so its runs are recorded only
health.observe: enrolled, and nothing is delivered or refused yet
health.healthy: frames arriving and no open incident

last30.note: Every tool definition on the belt is paid for as input on every call, whether the tool is used or not, which is why the belt width and the token bill are read together.

definition.title: Definition in git
definition.lead: Identity is in Postgres; the definition is a file, and the file is the source of truth.
definition.generatedSub: Written when the agent was proposed. A commit from this page writes the definition file alone.
definition.generatedNone: none: this harness reads no generated subagent file

empty.title: No steering is assembled for this agent
empty.body: No run of this agent in the last seven days recorded a steering manifest, so there is nothing assembled to show. Writing a record on Steering is what changes that.

observe.lead: Nothing below reaches this agent today.
observe.body: Its newest run is on the observe tier: no hook is installed, so Oxagen has no injection point. This is what the assembler would deliver on the harness tier.

prefix.label: Stable prefix
prefix.sub: SessionStart additional context against the 16 KiB cap
prefix.notBacked: The manifest does not record the stable prefix in bytes yet.

volatile.label: Volatile selection
volatile.sub: Token budget of the newest run
volatile.note: {included} items fit. {cut} items cut in all.

reaches.title: What reaches this agent
reaches.lead: {items} items compiled from the workspace library at {tokens} tok.

compiler.title: Open in the compiler
compiler.body: Oxagen would open the Steering compiler seeded with this agent. The compiler is not built yet, so nothing opens.

reaches.notBacked: The manifest records how many items reached this agent and not which ones. The item list waits on a per-agent assembly the assembler does not store yet.
reaches.note: A gate notice is never dropped for budget. Everything else competes: must and should for the 16 KiB SessionStart cap, then may and info ranked against the prompt.

cut.title: Cut for this agent
cut.notBacked: The manifest counts the cut items, {budget} of them for budget, and does not name them yet.

empty.title: No runtime is enrolled for this agent
empty.body: Until a host enrolls, this agent has an identity and a toolbelt but no hook is installed. Its runs would be graded observe, and no report could say more.

host.title: Host
host.lead: The enrollment tacho records for this host, the same record the host reports into.

open.label: Open the runtime
open.title: Open the runtime
open.body: Oxagen would open this host on the Runtimes page. That page is not built yet, so nothing opens.

host.harnessSub: the runtime is shared; every agent on it is seen through the same hooks
host.deviceKeySub: sha256 of the host’s Ed25519 key, which signs its checkpoints
host.proxyRoutedSub: every model call leaves through it; tokens are counted from the bytes that pass
host.proxyNotSub: model traffic goes from the harness to its provider. Routing it is the gateway tier.
host.tierSub: Computed per run from what was actually routed, as the newest run recorded it. The UI cannot render a stronger word than the tier allows.

tier.title: What this tier delivers
tier.lead: The tier is computed per run from what was actually routed.

all.label: All runtimes
all.title: All runtimes
all.body: Oxagen would open the Runtimes page with every host in this workspace. That page is not built yet, so nothing opens.

tier.noRun: No run of this agent is on the newest page of runs, so no tier is recorded for it.

rungs.observe: Recorded only. No hook is installed and nothing is delivered.
rungs.harness: Hooks installed. Steering is delivered and the four blocking hook events can refuse: client-attested and fail-open.
rungs.gateway: Model and MCP traffic routed through the gateway. Metering observed, budgets enforced on routed traffic.
rungs.contained: The agent runs under an OS sandbox whose only egress is the gateway. The only tier that earns the word enforced.

model.label: Model calls
model.observe: not routed through Oxagen. The harness calls its provider with its own key and reports usage. Spend is client_attested.
model.harness: not routed through Oxagen. The harness calls its provider with its own key and reports usage. Spend is client_attested.
model.gateway: routed through the loopback proxy on the host. Tokens are counted from the bytes that pass through it. Spend is gateway_observed.
model.contained: routed through the loopback proxy on the host. Tokens are counted from the bytes that pass through it. Spend is gateway_observed.

mcp.label: Tool calls over MCP
mcp.harness: the providers registered with Oxagen are routed through Oxagen and decided on the server. Any other MCP server the harness holds is not.
mcp.gateway: every provider the harness reaches over MCP is reached through the gateway and decided on the server.
mcp.contained: every provider the harness reaches over MCP is reached through the gateway and decided on the server.

native.label: Harness-native tools
native.harness: the four blocking hook events can refuse: client-attested and fail-open
native.gateway: the four blocking hook events can refuse: client-attested and fail-open
native.contained: the four blocking hook events can refuse, and the sandbox refuses a write to the settings file, the hook entries or the hook binary

budgets.label: Budgets
budgets.observe: a recorded number and a notice in steering, never a stop
budgets.harness: a recorded number and a notice in steering, never a stop
budgets.gateway: enforced before the call: a run budget by the proxy
budgets.contained: enforced before the call: a run budget by the proxy

steering.label: Steering
steering.observe: not delivered: no hook is installed
steering.harness: delivered at SessionStart and UserPromptSubmit, and as files in the checkout
steering.gateway: delivered at SessionStart and UserPromptSubmit, and as files in the checkout
steering.contained: delivered at SessionStart and UserPromptSubmit, and as files in the checkout

tier.note: The tier is computed per run from what was actually routed and rendered verbatim. No report can say a stronger word than the tier allows, and only contained earns the word enforced.

rollback.title: Rollback
rollback.lead: Shown beside the installer from the first screen, and never hidden afterwards.
rollback.note: Run it on the host: it removes the hooks and the service, revokes the enrollment, and deletes the host key. If hooks are stripped by hand instead, the next run records hooks_removed and the tier falls to observe. It is never upgraded after the fact.

smoke.label: Run a smoke session
smoke.title: Run a smoke session
smoke.body: Oxagen would queue one turn on this host, recorded like any other run. No contract starts a smoke session yet, so nothing is queued. Run the agent once on the host instead.

roles.title: Roles
roles.lead: Effective permission is its own grants ∩ the invoking human’s grants. Subagents can only narrow.
roles.wire: How the effective permission is computed
roles.beltSub: the belt its model is shown
roles.noneValue: none held. It can reach nothing but its own run channel.
roles.scope: {scope, select, org {organization role} other {workspace role}} since
roles.perRunSub: per run, from the definition file
roles.perDaySub: per day, kept in the definition file and not enforced
roles.noValue: no mandate, so a financial call is denied before dispatch
roles.note: Assigning a toolbelt grants nothing. It widens what the model is shown; every call on it is still decided against these roles, the policy on the tool, and the mandate ledger.

budgets.title: Budgets
budgets.lead: The per-run budget is the definition file’s. Once a wrapped session’s observed spend reaches it, the local model proxy refuses the session’s next model call on the gateway and contained tiers.
budgets.perRunNone: no priced run of this agent on the newest page of runs
budgets.highest: highest run on the newest page
budgets.perDayNote: kept in the definition file; nothing enforces it yet
budgets.perDayNone: No per-day ceiling is recorded for this agent, and nothing would enforce one yet.
budgets.modeValue: hard: the proxy refuses the next model call once observed spend reaches the per-run budget
budgets.breachValue: the session’s next model call is refused and the refusal is recorded as a frame

ceilingValue.caller: the agent's grants intersected with yours
ceilingValue.sentinel: no person resolved, so the unprivileged ceiling

runs.title: Runs
runs.empty: No run of this agent is on the newest page of runs. It has {count} in the last 30 days, and every one of them is in the audit record.
runs.emptyNoRollup: No run of this agent is on the newest page of runs, and the 30-day rollup holds none.

accounting.title: Token accounting
accounting.lead: By class, from this agent’s 30-day rollup.
accounting.none: The 30-day rollup holds no row for this agent.
accounting.note: Cache hit rate {rate}. The findings job flags a toolbelt wider than the agent uses, because those tokens are paid on every call whether the tool is used or not.
accounting.noteNoCache: No input token is recorded, so there is no cache hit rate.
accounting.notBacked: A class’s rate and cost, and the tool-definition share of input, are not recorded per class yet.

last30.title: Last 30 days
last30.lead: Read from the run records, not from the agent row.
last30.productiveSub: the share of spend on turns that produced a change
last30.noFinding: No finding is open against this agent.

rotate.title: Rotate the credential of {name}
rotate.body: The current key is refused at its next presentation and a new one is issued. The new secret is shown once.
rotate.done: The new credential, shown once. Store it now:

suspend.title: Suspend {name}
suspend.body: A suspended agent anchors no governed run and is shown an empty belt. Its credentials, roles and hosts stay as they are.

resume.title: Resume {name}
resume.body: The agent anchors governed runs again, with the credentials, roles and hosts it held.

retire.title: Deregister agent
retire.body: This ends the agent's identity. Its credentials and host enrollments are revoked, and its active mandates end.
retire.pullRequest: This dialog does not open the pull request that archives <mono>.oxagen/agents/{slug}.toml</mono> yet. Remove the file in a pull request of your own.
retire.keptValue: every run, frame and receipt. The record is never deleted.
retire.endsValue: {roles, plural, one {# role} other {# roles}}, {mandates, plural, one {# mandate} other {# mandates}}, {hosts, plural, =0 {no host enrollment} one {the host enrollment} other {# host enrollments}}
retire.endsUnknown: its roles, mandates and host enrollment
retire.inFlightUnrecorded: live runs not counted yet, and deregistering does not cancel them
retire.understand: I understand this cannot be undone
retire.endsValueNoRoles: the roles it holds, {mandates, plural, one {# mandate} other {# mandates}}, {hosts, plural, =0 {no host enrollment} one {the host enrollment} other {# host enrollments}}
retire.done: {name} deregistered. Credential revoked, every run and frame kept.

killSwitch.title: Stop {name} now
killSwitch.body: An emergency deny against every tool call this agent makes, and a pause for every run of it still live.
killSwitch.blastTitle: This stops the agent, not one run
killSwitch.blastBody: Every tool call this agent makes is denied from its next call boundary. A run of it already open is paused now, not cancelled: an operator can resume it once the switch is off.
killSwitch.needsRole: The kill switch needs an organization Owner or Admin role.
killSwitch.unchanged: This agent's kill switch was already on. The pause below still ran.

mandates.title: Mandates held
mandates.lead: A mandate is bounded, expiring authority for the consequences it names. Nothing in a role, a grant or a toolbelt substitutes for one.
mandates.none: No mandate is recorded for this agent — none granted, and none requested — so it cannot carry a consequence.
mandates.noneDetail: A call that carries a consequence tag is denied before dispatch — before any credential is minted and before anything reaches a tool server — whether or not the tool is on this agent's belt.
mandates.authority: Remaining authority is what the ledger says: every draw reserves, then settles against a receipt or releases. The tools a mandate covers appear on the belt gated by mandate and approval, never as plainly allowed.

request.title: Request a mandate
request.body: The request is recorded as a draft for the role accountable for this consequence to grant or decline. A draft grants nothing.
request.measureHint: The name the tool version declares the figure under, which is how it is read from a call. It cannot be “calls”: every call draws one of those, and the field below sets that limit. Leave the measure fields blank to limit calls alone — the only limit a tool that declares no measure can carry.
request.perPeriodHint: Name a per-call limit, a per-period limit, or both.
request.toolsHint: Patterns over slug@version, separated by commas. Everything else is denied.
request.purposeHint: Written for the office that reads the ledger.
request.validToHint: A mandate expires. There is no unbounded option.
request.unitHint: What the measure counts, in the name the tool version declares — rows, recipients, GB. It must be the declared unit: the gate reads a call in that unit, so a limit denominated in another is enforced as a figure nobody entered, and the request is refused. Not a currency code: a limit in money is scaled by the tool’s declaration, which nothing here can read, so it is asked for over the API or MCP instead.
request.perCallHint: Whole units of the measure. The figure is recorded exactly as typed and is never scaled, so the limit this request carries is the figure entered.
request.consequenceTagsHint: Name every consequence the covered tools declare. A mandate covers a tool only when it names all of them — name one of a tool’s two and the mandate is granted as asked and the call is still denied. The six above are the starter set; a workspace defines its own, and those go in the field beneath.
request.consequenceOther: Others the tools declare, separated by commas

mandates.noneListed: No mandate listed here is in effect. The list above is not complete, so that is not a statement that the agent holds no authority.
mandates.noneListedDetail: An org Owner, Admin, Billing or Compliance reader sees every mandate recorded in the workspace. Ask one of them whether this agent holds authority, or read the Tools ledger with that role.
mandates.retired: This agent is retired, so it cannot be given a mandate: its principal is suspended and authority granted now could never be drawn. The mandates recorded for it stay listed.
mandates.noneEffectiveUpcoming: No mandate recorded for this agent is in effect yet, so it cannot carry a consequence. A mandate granted below has not reached the date it starts on; any others are a request awaiting a decision, or history.

empty.title: This agent has never run
